title: Twelve-bit affine tags and packed correction entries

claims.statement: The explicit ten-block affine line code and its scalar decoder in proof.md for 1000 information bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses have uniform-message average block error at most 124410706854418567/125000000000000000.
The stated scalar bsc-ops-v1 decoder for the same affine line code executes at most the integer W=234599456 operations for every received word, with W<=2^(13903/500).

experiments.purpose: Recompute an exact sector of the local spectra. The final sector also calculates the full affine line spectrum and block error bound, and checks memory, packed metrics and exact operation exponent.
